_comment: Items of carried mods that cannot work in Horizon today. hide_unplaceable.py removes them from the creative tabs and drops every recipe (and recipe advancement) that mentions them. Keys are mod namespaces; `patterns` are fnmatch patterns over item names. `drop_items: false` keeps the item registered so saved worlds and tags that name it still load.

regions_unexplored.reason: Boats are entities. Horizon only places minecraft:<wood>_boat, `_chest_boat` and `_raft` (horizon-client game/boats.rs any_boat_wood) and has no entity layer for mods, so a modded boat item does nothing when used.
